<article class="case-study">

  <header class="case-study__header">
    <div class="case-study__kicker">Program design &amp; launch · Federally-funded research initiative</div>
    <h1 class="case-study__title">Building an education program</h1>
    <p class="case-study__dek">Ground up build of an education and outreach division for a federally-funded phylogenetics initiative — including a researcher-educator workshop model with results that surprised the people who commissioned it.</p>
    <ul class="case-skills">
      <li>Program design and launch</li>
      <li>Cross-functional team leadership</li>
      <li>Workshop facilitation</li>
      <li>Instructional technology development</li>
      <li>Stakeholder management</li>
    </ul>
  </header>

  <section class="case-study__section">
    <h2>The problem</h2>
    <p>A federally-funded phylogenetics research initiative had no education or outreach component. The science was significant and publicly funded, but inaccessible to educators and the broader public. No one on the team had built this kind of program before.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="case-study__section">
    <h2>What I did</h2>
    <p>I created the vision, strategy, and structure for an education division from scratch. I built and coordinated a distributed cross-functional team — computer scientists, phylogenetics researchers, and educators across multiple institutions — and developed interactive web-based phylogenetic learning tools in R, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.</p>
    <p>The centerpiece was the inaugural subject-specialist/educator collaborative workshop: a model that brought researchers and teachers together to co-produce educational resources from large-scale biological datasets. </p>

   
    <div class="pull-quote">Designing the workshop meant designing the structure that would let two professional cultures actually do work together — rather than presenting at one another.</div>
  
  </section>

  <section class="case-study__section">
    <h2>The outcome</h2>

    <div class="big-stat-grid">
      <div class="big-stat">
        <div class="big-stat__numbers">
          <span class="big-stat__after">100%</span>
        </div>
        <div class="big-stat__caption">Positive participant feedback from the inaugural researcher-educator workshop.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="big-stat">
        <div class="big-stat__numbers">
          <span class="big-stat__after">&lt; 1 yr</span>
        </div>
        <div class="big-stat__caption">From scoping to a launched program division, with a working workshop model and a published OER suite.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p>The workshop produced a suite of open educational resources that are still publicly available. Organizers described the outcome as unlike anything they had seen before — the model demonstrated that researchers and educators could productively co-create in a structured collaborative format, a result that surprised the broader team.</p>
  </section>
